summary: Kerb along a grassy park with homes only across the road.
reasons: Homes across the road, over 10 m
Other cars park along the street

drivers.seclusion: Open park and a few trees on the kerb side; houses across the road, roughly 15 to 20 m off.
drivers.access_and_room: Plain kerb on a wide residential street; a van fits beside the parked cars.
drivers.traffic: Quiet suburban street with a junction at each end of the section.
drivers.convention: Cars park along both sides nearby; signs are 2P with resident permits, Monday to Friday 7am to 7pm only.

flags: Houses face the park across the road
sun_shade: Open to the south over the park; large trees to the east shade the road at times.

best_section.where: Marmion Pde beside the park, just east of the side-street junction
